# ClaudeLog

> > Community-driven documentation hub for Claude Code, covering agent engineering, MCP integrations, workflow optimization, and CLAUDE.md configuration patterns.

ClaudeLog serves as the comprehensive resource for Claude Code users, featuring tutorials, mechanics guides, and FAQs from the r/ClaudeAI community. The site documents core concepts like agent engineering with CLAUDE.md, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, skills systems, and advanced workflow patterns for AI-assisted development.

## Key Topics

- Claude Code
- CLAUDE.md
- Agent Engineering
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Workflow Optimization
- Skills System
- Plan Mode
- Task/Agent Tools
- MCP Servers
- Allowed Tools & Permissions
- Named Sessions
- Git Worktrees
- Parallel Execution
- Tool Maker Pattern
- Configuration Management

## Getting Started

- [What is ClaudeLog - Claude Code Documentation Site](https://www.claudelog.com/faqs/what-is-claudelog): About ClaudeLog: Community-driven Claude Code documentation from r/ClaudeAI

- [Claude Code Usage](https://www.claudelog.com/claude-code-usage): Usage patterns, optimization strategies, and Sonnet/Opus model selection

- [Agent Engineering](https://www.claudelog.com/mechanics/agent-engineering): Custom agent system fundamentals, CLAUDE.md, and best practices

## Session & Interface Management

- [What are Named Sessions in Claude Code](https://www.claudelog.com/faqs/what-are-named-sessions-in-claude-code): Named sessions with /rename and /resume commands for session management
- [What is Micro-Compact in Claude Code](https://www.claudelog.com/faqs/what-is-micro-compact): Micro-compact auto-clears tool calls to extend session length
- [How to Customize Status Line in Claude Code](https://www.claudelog.com/faqs/status-line-claude-code): Customize Claude Code status line with statusline-setup agent
- [How to Edit Prompts in External Editor in Claude Code](https://www.claudelog.com/faqs/how-to-edit-prompt-in-editor-in-claude-code): Use Ctrl+G to edit prompts in Vim, VSCode, or Emacs external editors
- [How to Search History in Claude Code](https://www.claudelog.com/faqs/how-to-search-history-in-claude-code): Search command history with Ctrl+R reverse search in v2.0.0+
